summary: THREE CONFIRMED SCHEMA DRIFTS that make parts of the news feed silently empty, all found by applying the Wave 35 Objective-3 lesson (absence of findings is not evidence) to discover's own surface. None produces a tsc diagnostic, a test failure, or a CodeQL alert. All three are database-owned fixes; discover could not apply them and did NOT paper over them by deleting the offending columns. A fourth item, `artist_music`'s trust columns, is only a CONTRACT-staleness problem and needs no action. (1) `artist_blog_posts.format` — the column is created ONLY by supabase/migration-archive/pre-reconciliation-local-only-2026-08-20/20260717220000_press_content_formats.sql, which is ARCHIVED and not in the active chain. lib/news/feed-service.ts:376-397 selects it and filters `.in('format', ['article','blog'])` on it, so PostgREST 400s and the ENTIRE blog section of the news feed is empty. Live code depends on it, so the fix is to port that migration back, not to remove the select. (2) `music_tracks.{origin_status,certification_status,certification_level,certification_public_id}` — `music_tracks` is a VIEW whose projection (supabase/migrations/20260711165607_native_music_player_hardening.sql:118-158) does not include those four columns; they were added to the base TABLE afterwards at supabase/migrations/20260910140000_artist_music_trust_columns.sql:12-15, and a base-table column does not appear in an existing view. The select 400s and the entire music section of the news feed is empty. Fix: an additive `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.music_tracks` that adds the four columns. (3) `user_news_preferences` and `user_news_subscriptions` — created by NO migration anywhere under supabase/. The code's `catch { // Table may not exist yet in early rollout }` comment is therefore not describing a temporary state: the news personalization signal (subscribed topics, subscribed sources) is PERMANENTLY empty. Fix: either author the two tables additively, or delete the dead reads.

completed: Established the active chain is the 306 files under supabase/migrations matching ^\d{14}_[a-z0-9_]+\.sql$, the same predicate scripts/ci/check-active-migration-chain.mjs uses, and searched exactly that set rather than the whole supabase/ tree.

Item 1: `artist_blog_posts` is created in the active chain at supabase/migrations/20260702210503_account_aware_blog_publishing.sql:9-33 and extended at :54-61. Neither adds `format`, and `rg -n 'artist_blog_posts' supabase/migrations/*.sql | rg -i format` returns nothing. `format`, `distribution`, `subtitle`, `boilerplate` and `embargo_until` all come from the ARCHIVED 20260717220000_press_content_formats.sql. lib/database.types.ts `artist_blog_posts.Row` has 25 columns and none of them is `format`.

Item 2: `music_tracks` is a view, last redefined at supabase/migrations/20260711165607_native_music_player_hardening.sql:118-158 as `select ... from public.artist_music tracks left join public.profiles ...`. Its explicit projection does not include the four trust columns, and the only migration that adds them targets `public.artist_music`, not the view. `drop view if exists public.music_tracks cascade; create view ...` in that migration is the shape a redefinition must follow.
Item 3: `rg -ln 'user_news_preferences|user_news_subscriptions' supabase/migrations/*.sql` and the same search over all of `supabase/` both return nothing. No migration creates either table.

Discovered and DISCARDED a proposed in-file 'fix': removing `format` from the select. It would have made the blog section non-empty, but it deletes a column the press lane owns and that __tests__/press/press-formats-and-news.test.ts:30 asserts on, and it would convert a visible schema regression into an invisible one. Reverted. discover does not get to decide whether press formats are still a product requirement.

Removed the dead 'legacy' retry that sat in fetchBlogCandidates. It re-selected `format` and so could never succeed; the only observable difference is that the PostgREST error is now logged once instead of twice.

Made every failure LOUD rather than silent, which is the part discover could do without touching the schema: fetchBlogCandidates and fetchMusicCandidates now destructure `error`, log `[News feed] ... query failed: <message>`, and return []. Previously both discarded `error` entirely.

Pinned all of it in __tests__/news/news-feed-schema-drift.test.ts: a general guard parses lib/database.types.ts and every `.from(...).select(...)` in lib/news/**, failing on any column the contract does not declare, with a 7-entry ACCEPTED list so the guard is fail-closed for NEW drift and each existing exception must stay annotated in source.

CROSS-REFERENCE, so the receiver can act without re-deriving: two artifacts added by CONCURRENT lanes in Wave 35 land on this exact problem. (a) supabase/tests/db008_view_column_replay_plan.mjs, supabase/tests/db008_view_column_replay.harness.sh and supabase/tests/db008_view_relation_list.txt are a database-lane view-column replay harness — item 2 is exactly a view-projection gap, so that harness is the tool that would have caught it, and its relation list should be extended to assert music_tracks exposes the four trust columns. (b) HF-RELEASE-035-TYPE-REGEN-OPERATOR records that the database lane has proven the active chain is a SUPERSET of the generated contract (13 relations, 54 columns, 42 callables added, ZERO contract-only entries). That is consistent with item 2 and does not rescue it: a column existing on the base table is not the same as the view projecting it. It also means items 1 and 3 are NOT a regeneration problem at all — the column/table is absent from the chain too, so regenerating lib/database.types.ts cannot fix them.
next_steps: Item 2, fastest route: the database lane's Wave 35 view-column replay harness (supabase/tests/db008_view_column_replay_plan.mjs and .harness.sh) already replays view definitions. Add music_tracks to its relation list asserting the four trust columns, which will reproduce this failure locally and turn the fix into a verified one rather than an assumed one.

Item 1 (highest user impact): port supabase/migration-archive/pre-reconciliation-local-only-2026-08-20/20260717220000_press_content_formats.sql into the active chain as a new additive migration with a NEW version number. Do not move the archived file — the archive is evidence. The SQL is already `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` and idempotent, and its `DO $$ ... IF NOT EXISTS (pg_constraint)` guard is already collision-safe. Coordinate with the press lane, because lib/blog/article-publishing.ts reads and writes `format` and `distribution` and the press suite asserts on the feed-service filter.

Item 1 alternative, and a product decision discover cannot make: if press formats were deliberately cut, then the coordinated change is to delete `format`/`distribution` from lib/blog/article-publishing.ts, lib/press/formats.ts, the feed-service select, AND __tests__/press/press-formats-and-news.test.ts in one change. Do not do only the feed-service half; that is the version discover reverted.

Item 2: author an additive `drop view if exists public.music_tracks cascade; create view public.music_tracks as ...` that adds origin_status, certification_status, certification_level and certification_public_id to the projection, re-apply the `security_invoker = true` setting from the current definition, and confirm nothing depends on the old narrower column list. If the cascade is unacceptable in the target environment, add the four columns to the view with `ALTER VIEW ... ADD COLUMN` instead, which is non-cascading.

Item 2 alternative: if the view must not change, then lib/news/feed-service.ts must read the trust fields from `artist_music` directly in a second query keyed on the same `id`. That is a discover-side change and is deliberately NOT taken here because it would change what the news item's trust label displays, which is a trust-surface decision rather than a mechanical one.

Item 3: decide whether news personalization is in scope. If yes, author both tables additively with the columns lib/news/feed-service.ts already selects (`topics`/`preferred_sources` on user_news_preferences; `subscription_type`/`subscription_key` on user_news_subscriptions) plus `user_id`. If no, delete the dead reads so the signal is honestly absent rather than silently empty.

Regenerate lib/database.types.ts after whichever items land, so the generated contract stops being a third opinion that disagrees with the code. The full `npm run typecheck` cannot be run on the current 8GB box (CI measures 68m18s and 1,384 pre-existing diagnostics), so this lane cannot measure the reduction.

After each item lands, the ACCEPTED list in __tests__/news/news-feed-schema-drift.test.ts must shrink by one per resolved item and the in-file KNOWN DRIFT annotation must be removed. The test fails if an annotation is deleted without the drift being fixed, and fails if a new exception is added without editing the count assertion.
blockers: discover cannot apply any of this: supabase/** and lib/database.types.ts are both outside its ownership, and CP-051 forbids this lane from applying a migration even if it could author one. No migration was authored, applied, or modified by this lane, and `supabase db reset` was not run.

No hosted or credentialed verification was performed and none is claimed. The claim that each select 400s is derived from the DDL in the active chain plus PostgREST's documented behaviour for a select of a non-existent column, not from an observed request. Release/QA should confirm by enabling the new error logs and watching for `[News feed] Blog candidate query failed` / `[News feed] Music candidate query failed` in a deployed environment.

The generated contract is an approximation and is stale in at least one direction independently of these three items: `app/api/feed/music/route.ts:174` selects the same four trust columns from `artist_music`, where they DO exist in the active chain, so that select works and only the contract is behind. A failure of the guard test therefore means 'the contract and the active chain disagree somewhere', not always 'this select is broken'.

The press lane's source-text test __tests__/press/press-formats-and-news.test.ts:30 asserts `.in('format', ['article', 'blog'])` is present in lib/news/feed-service.ts. Any coordinated removal of the press-format feature must update that test in the same change.

lib/news/feed-service.ts reaches every one of these tables through the un-generic `SupabaseClient` type (see lib/supabase/service-role.ts:14 and the `supabase: SupabaseClient` parameter annotations), which is why none of this produced a diagnostic.
